The king's murderer must have fled there.|Jedi General Anakin Skywalker|{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}}} The '''''Providence''-class Dreadnought''', otherwise referred to as the '''''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer''', '''''Providence''-class cruiser-carrier''', or simply the '''Separatist dreadnought''', was a model of [[dreadnought]] designed by [[Quarren]] [[engineer]]s on the [[planet]] [[Pammant]], seeing extensive deployment by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|naval branch]] throughout the duration of the [[Clone Wars]]. Initially utilized as [[command ship]]s by the [[Trade Federation fleet|private fleet]] of the [[Trade Federation]], where it was debuted with the ''[[Invisible Hand]]'', the personal [[flagship]] of [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray]]. The [[warship]] was cautiously deployed by the Confederacy's [[Navy|naval]] admiralty, due to the high operational costs for such a [[Starship|vessel]], but was utilized in situations where its capabilities were necessary. Manufactured by [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]], the ''Providence''-class Dreadnought cost millions of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] to purchase. It was introduced via the ''Invisible Hand'' following the Trade Federation's defeat and subsequent sanctions in their failed [[Invasion of Naboo|invasion]] of the planet [[Naboo]] in [[32 BBY]]. Years after their losses, in [[22 BBY]], the Federation became an ally of the Separatist Alliance. In their allegiance, the company's military forces, such as its navy and warships, including the ''Providence''-class, were incorporated into to the [[Confederacy military]]. From that point onward, several of the dreadnought class were utilized and constructed by the Confederacy, including the ''[[Invincible]]'' and ''[[Invulnerable]]'', which were [[Commanding officer|commanded]] by the [[Harch]] [[Admiral]] [[Trench]] during the war, the former which was destroyed in a [[Battle of Christophsis|siege]] of the planet [[Christophsis]], and the latter destroyed with its commander during a [[Battle of Anaxes|battle]] for the planet [[Anaxes]]. While the ''Invisible Hand'' was owned by [[Viceroy]] Gunray, initially, command over the warship was later debated among the Separatist leadership, including by the [[Executive Separatist Council]]. However, ownership of the dreadnought was reluctantly surrendered and transferred by Gunray to [[Supreme Martial Commander of the Separatist Droid Armies|Supreme Martial Commander]] [[General]] [[Grievous]], to the general's own delight. Under Grievous's command, the ''Invisible Hand'' became the primary capital ship of the Confederacy navy by [[19 BBY]]. From there, it eventually came to serve in Grievous's massive [[Battle of Coruscant|assault]] on the [[Galactic Republic]] [[capital]] world of [[Coruscant]], in which the vessel was destroyed during the battle. Following the war's end, in the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], several of the ''Providence''-class Dreadnought were transported around [[the galaxy]] for disassembly, such as on the planet [[Bracca]] and at the [[Bilbringi shipyards]]. The ''[[Lucid Voice]]'', which was disassembled at Bilbringi and had fought during the war in several contested [[star system]]s, saw reutilization of its various components, alongside those of the long-destroyed ''Invincible'' dreadnought, in a [[Berch Teller's warship|down-sized version]] of a ''Providence''-class Dreadnought used by Imperial defector [[Berch Teller]]. Furthermore, the dreadnought class also saw redeployment in the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|armada]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]], such as a member of the dreadnought's [[Providence-class Carrier|carrier variation]]. ==Characteristics== ===Dimensions=== [[File:Separatistdeckgun.png|thumb|left|350px|A Separatist flak gun battery on board the ''Invisible Hand''.]] Designed and constructed by the [[Quarren]] builders of the [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]],{{EncyclopediaCite|Republic and Separatist Ships (1)}} as well as [[Rendili StarDrive]], manufacturing company in the [[Factory|construction facilities]] on the [[planet]] [[Pammant]], the ''Providence''-class Dreadnought was a type of [[dreadnought]] that cost 400,585,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] and consisted of two models of different sizes, one that measured to 1,088 [[meter]]s in length and another at 2,000 meters. Propelled by a trio of [[Creveld-4 radial ion drive]]s manufactured by [[Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated|Nubia Star Drives, Inc.]], the Providence was capable of traveling at maximum acceleration of 2,500 [[G (unit)|G]], as well as seventy [[megalight per hour]] and a maximum [[Atmosphere|atmospheric]] speed of 2,000 [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]]. In addition to its propulsion systems, the ''Providence''-class was capable of traveling through [[hyperspace]] via its Class 1.5 and supplementary Class 10 [[hyperdrive]] generators, while it was also equipped with long-range [[sensor]]s, a [[navigation computer]], and was powered by several [[reactor]]s. One of the largest and most powerful [[warship]]s to have been deployed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|naval forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]] against the [[Galactic Republic]], the dreadnought was constructed of a highly modular design, whose long and roughly cylindrical [[hull]] possessed a tapered, cone-like bow, while its aftward sections were dominated by a bulky superstructure with a towering fin-like spire that erected from the dorsal surface of its hull, which also supported its command [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] and observation platforms. Accessible by a series of five [[turbolift]]s, the topmost level of the spire contained the private quarters of the warship's [[commanding officer]], as well as a singular command center that retained several tactical display screens and briefing tables, which were located within an observation platform with a 180-degree [[viewport]] of the surrounding [[Realspace|space]]. [[File:TheseAreNotTheDroidsYouAreLookingFor-TCWND.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The hangar aboard a Providence-class]] Furthermore, along its hull's dorsal surface, ''Providence''-class vessels were equipped with several [[sensor]] and [[Comm unit|communications]] masts that were used to coordinate its nearby [[droid starfighter]] defenses, while aboard its command bridge, which differed in design language, warships of the ''Providence''-class retained a series of yellow-lighted display screens utilized by its crew of 900 [[officer]]s, [[droid]]s and additional crewmembers to control the vessel's various systems. In addition, the command bridge provided its commanding officer and crew with a 180-degree view of the surrounding space through several viewports, while in the center of the command center was a throne-like chair designated for its commander. As a result of the warship's simple construction and highly modular interior designs, vessels of the class were configurable in order to fulfill a variety of different starship roles. One such role was fulfilled by the [[Providence-class Carrier|''Providence''-class Carrier]] variant, as well as a series of several others, which gave the craft a form of versatility and made it more useful to its operators in contrast to other specialized vessels. ===Weapon systems and shielding=== Along its hull, the cylindrical surface of the ''Providence''-class was dotted with variety of weapon emplacements, and therefore provided the craft enough firepower to maintain a planetary [[blockade]] alone. Its weapons were also powerful enough to pierce through the [[deflector shield]]s of other enemy warships. The armament of a ''Providence''-class consisted of fourteen port and starboard heavy [[quad turbolaser cannon]]s, thirty-four dorsal and ventral [[turret]]-mounted dual heavy [[laser cannon]]s, twelve port and starboard twin light [[point-defense ion cannon]]s, and two forward-mounted battleship heavy [[ion cannon]]s. Additionally, the dreadnought was also armed with 102 [[proton torpedo launcher]]s, which could each fire a total of three [[Proton torpedo|torpedoes]], as well as twelve heavy [[flak gun]]s, and ten port and starboard heavy [[tractor beam]] [[Tractor beam projector|emitters]].
[[File:ThermalShields-CaM.png|thumb|225px|The ''Providence''-class Dreadnoughts' thermal shields]]
In addition to its sturdy hull and some of the thickest [[armor]] in its class, the ''Providence''-class was equipped with deflector shields as well as [[thermal shield]]s, which were powerful enough to turn or absorb the heaviest [[laser]] fire from opposing starships. While extremely potent vessels, the Separatist admiralty deployed the ''Providence''-class ships with great caution, and due to the high cost of operating these vessels at their peak efficiency, they were deployed only when their sheer, overwhelming force was called upon. ===Complement=== [[File:ProvidenceClassDreadnought-SWM42.png|thumb|left|250px|A ''Providence''-class Dreadnought disgorges a stream of Vulture droids]] Despite possessing a fearsome armament, the ''Providence''-class Dreadnought was designed to often take the role of a carrier for starfighters and [[landing craft]] of the Separatist armada. Sporting a large [[hangar]] for its complement, the dreadnought could carry up to 120 [[Vulture-class starfighter|''Vulture''-class droid starfighters]], 120 [[droid tri-fighter]]s, and 10 [[Hyena-class Droid Fighter/Bomber|''Hyena''-class Droid Fighter/Bombers]]. These vessels were also capable of transporting several hundred droid armored vehicles, such as [[Multi-Troop Transport]]s and [[Armored Assault Tank Mk I|Armored Assault Tanks]],''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]'' as well as [[shuttle]]s, and [[HMP droid gunship]]s, while also ferrying a passenger capacity of 48,247 [[troop]]s and manned by a crew of 900 officers, droids, and other enlisted crew. The ''Providence''-class was also able carry 1.5 million deactivated [[battle droid]]s, and maintained a cargo capacity of 18,000 [[metric ton]]s. ===Propulsion and navigation=== Boasting a speed of 2,000 [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]] and a speed of 70 [[megalight per hour]] from three [[Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated|Nubian]] [[Creveld-4 radial ion drive]]s, the ''Providence''-class was equipped with a Class 1.5 [[hyperdrive]] generator as well as a backup Class 10 hyperdrive. The vessel was also equipped with long-range [[sensor]]s, as well as a [[navigation computer]]. ==Role== The primary role of the ''Providence''-class Dreadnought was to act as the [[command ship]] of [[fleet]]s. However, it could also take the role of a cruiser-carrier, where it could ferry a large passenger complement as well as a vehicle and starfighter complement in its hangars. ==History== ===Clone Wars=== ====Battle of Christophsis==== =====Repelling the Republic===== [[File:InvincibleBearingDown-CaM.png|thumb|right|300px|The ''Invincible'' bears down on Skywalker's fleet]] In [[22 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' during the [[Clone Wars]] between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, the Confederacy dispatched its Droid Army under the command of [[Kerkoiden]] [[General]] [[Whorm Loathsom]][[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] and [[Sith assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress]] to the [[crystal]]line planet [[Christophsis]], due to its resources and strategic position along the [[Corellian Run]]. After managing to occupy the planet's surface, the Confederacy proceeded to establish a thirty-craft [[Christophsis blockade|blockade]] of at least six [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|''Lucrehulk''-class Battleships]] and at least twenty-three [[Munificent-class star frigate|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] in orbit under the command of [[Harch]] [[Admiral]] [[Trench]] aboard his flagship, the ''Providence''-class Dreadnought ''[[Invincible]]''. Following the blockade's establishment, the Republic dispatched a [[Skywalker's fleet|fleet]] of three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] and three [[Pelta-class frigate|''Pelta''-class frigates]] under the command of Jedi General [[Anakin Skywalker]] to Christophsis, where they were to [[Battle of Christophsis|break]] through the blockade and deliver relief supplies to the surface. As the two fleets exchanged fire with one another, the ''Invincible'' proceeded to make its advancement on the ''Resolute'' unopposed, which forced the Republic fleet to increase power to their forward shields. Releasing a barrage of turbolaser fire upon Skywalker's fleet, the ''Invincible'' managed to separate the Republic [[frigate]]s from the Venators, destroying one of the frigates in the process. As the ''Invincible'' continued its bombardment, Skywalker ordered his fleet to over-fire their reactors, with the intent of charging through the blockade. In response, Trench ordered the blockade to maintain their position and intensify their forward deflector shields. Shortly after, Jedi General [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived in the [[Christoph system|system]] aboard his flagship, who advised Skywalker to withdraw his forces behind the [[moon]] of [[Leesis]], informing him that he had devised a plan, to which Skywalker followed suit. As the Republic fleet fled to the other side of the moon, Trench's [[T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|T-series tactical droid]] [[TI-99]] inquired as to whether or not they should pursue, to which the Harch responded that their orders were to hold a blockade and that the Republic would return. After the Republic retreated, Trench ordered two [[B1-series battle droid]]s of the dreadnought's crew to recharge the vessel's shields and to allow their cannons to reset. =====Destruction of the ''Invincible''===== [[File:InvincibleBridge-CaM.png|thumb|left|300px|Trench commands the blockade from the bridge of the ''Invincible''.]] While the Republic recuperated behind the moon, Trench ordered TI-99 to provide an update on the surface engagements, to which the [[tactical droid]] explained that he estimated a half rotation before the Confederacy could take control of the planet. In response, Trench, who believed that a two-pronged attack would draw the Republic out, dispatched a [[squadron]] of ''Hyena''-class Droid Bombers to the surface, where they were to [[bomb]] [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa's]] position. As the bombers made their approach on Senator Organa, the squadron unknowingly flew directly over General Skywalker, who was ordered by Kenobi to use a prototype [[IPV-2C Stealth Corvette|stealth ship]] and deliver the relief supplies to surface. Not long after the bombing run, Skywalker, resolute in defeating the blockade, went on the offensive and attacked the ''Invincible''. Deactivating the stealth ship's [[cloaking device]], the [[Jedi Knight]] revealed himself to Trench and fired several [[torpedo]]es on the ''Invincible''{{'s}} command bridge. Repelled by the dreadnought's thermal shields, the Harch proceeded to order his crew to fire a wall of turbolaser fire, but were unsuccessful as the ship reactivated its cloaking device. Despite being unsuccessful, however, Trench came to the realization that a [[clone trooper]] would be unable to navigate a spread of lasers, and that they were instead battling a Jedi, to which the Harch proceeded to contact Skywalker aboard the stealth ship. As Trench spoke with the Republic crew, the Harch warned them to turn back while they were, and that despite them being in possession of an impressive vessel, he informed them that he has fought with similar vessels in the past. [[File:InvincibleDestroyed-CaM.png|thumb|right|300px|The ''Invincible'' is destroyed by tracking torpedoes.]] After the transmission ended, Trench hypothesized that, in spite of his message, Skywalker was unlikely to retreat and would strike again, understanding that a stealth ship would have been able to slip by the blockade without being noticed, but instead chose to attack. Affirming Trench's hypothesis, Skywalker once again disengaged the cloaking device, firing torpedoes at the dreadnought, which were repelled once more and allowed Trench to track the stealth ship's magnetic signature before it could disappear again. Upon locking onto its magnetic signature, the ''Invincible'', lowering it shields to do so, fired several [[tracking torpedo]]es toward the stealth ship, which managed to evade the torpedoes, disengaging the cloaking device once more as it increased engine power, heading straight for the unshielded ''Invincible'' and sending the torpedoes into its bridge, destroying the vessel as a result. With the ''Invincible'' destroyed, Kenobi and the Republic fleet returned and continued their attack on the blockade, which had been thrown into disarray following the dreadnought's destruction. ====Attacking the Felucia medical station==== [[File:FeluciaMedicalStationDestroyed-BH.png|thumb|left|270px|Felucia Medical Station HCTFF2 is destroyed]] Some time after the Confederacy's [[First Battle of Felucia|triumph]] over the Republic on [[Felucia]] to gain access to the [[Perlemian Trade Route]] in [[21 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the [[Mission to Mustafar (Skywalker and Tano)|mission to Mustafar]] and the [[Zillo Beast incident]] to [[21 BBY]]. As the episode this event takes place within takes place between the events of the episodes the other events are attached to according to {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}}, this event must also take place 21 BBY. the Separatist [[navy]] launched an [[Destruction of the Felucia medical station|attack]] on [[Felucia Medical Station HCTFF2]], a Republic [[Haven-class medical station|''Haven''-class medical station]] located in the [[Felucia system]], led by a ''Providence''-class Dreadnought and two ''Munificent''-class star frigates, which resulted in the [[Medcenter|medical station's]] destruction.{{TCW|Bounty Hunters (episode)}} ====Battles of Kamino and Sullust==== [[File:CISfleet-ARCTroopers.png|thumb|right|250px|The Separatist fleet during the Battle of Kamino led by a Separatist dreadnought]] Despite the [[Defense of Rishi Station|failure]] of their first attempt earlier in the Clone Wars,{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}} the [[Kaleesh]] cyborg General [[Grievous]] and [[Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress]] of the Confederacy planned to launch a second [[Battle of Kamino|invasion]] attempt on the cloning planet of [[Kamino]]. However, the Republic intercepted a transmission between the two detailing the invasion of Kamino, which resulted in the clones of the [[501st Legion]] being deployed to help defend the planet.{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}} When he arrived in the [[Kamino system]], Grievous commanded the fleet from his [[Grievous's Providence-class carrier/destroyer (Kamino)|personal]] ''Providence''-class Dreadnought, which was flanked by several ''Munificent''-class star frigates and [[Recusant-class light destroyer|''Recusant''-class light destroyers]]. [[File:BattleOfSullustSystem_Nightsisters.png|thumb|left|250px|A Providence led a Separatist fleet during the Battle of Sullust.]] Later, a [[Unidentified Providence-class carrier/destroyer (Battle of Sullust)|''Providence''-class Dreadnought]] flagged a Separatist [[Asajj Ventress's fleet|fleet]] that was placed under the command of the [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]] assassin Asajj Ventress, crossed paths with a Republic fleet commanded by both Jedi Generals Skywalker and Kenobi, which resulted in a [[Battle of Sullust|battle]] to claim control over the planet [[Sullust]].{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}} By the end of the battle, [[Count]] [[Dooku]], who was ordered by his [[Sith Master|master]] [[Darth Sidious]] to destroy his assassin to prove his loyalty, instructed Ventress' tactical droid, [[TJ-912]], to withdraw their forces and open fire on the Separatist command ship, where the dark acolyte was caught in a brief [[lightsaber duel]] between Skywalker and Kenobi, ultimately causing the dreadnought's destruction, but not before Ventress could narrowly escape the doomed vessel. ====Discovering the Nexus Route==== After Jedi Master [[Even Piell]] had discovered the location of the strategic [[Nexus Route]] hyperspace lane, Piell's forces were [[Capture of Even Piell|ambushed]] by a small fleet of Separatist warships led by a ''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer, which led to the Jedi Master being imprisoned in the seemingly inescapable [[Citadel]] on the [[Volcano|volcanic]] planet [[Lola Sayu]].{{TCW|The Citadel (episode)}} Following Master Piell's capture by Separatist forces, the Republic dispatched a Jedi-led rescue team to [[Battle of Lola Sayu|extract]] their fellow Jedi from the Citadel to prevent the Confederacy from learning the hyperlane's coordinates. Entering the [[Lola Sayu system]] aboard a [[Shuttle 81572|stolen ''Sheathipede''-class Type B shuttle]], the Republic's rescue team crossed paths with the Separatists' planetary [[Lola Sayu defense fleet|defense fleet]] which was commanded by a Separatist dreadnought. [[File:BattleOfLolaSayuEscape-CR.png|thumb|right|270px|The Separatist fleet engages the attacking Republic fleet.]] After the Jedi freed Master Piell from the Citadel, the stolen shuttle in which the Republic arrived on was destroyed while trying to make their escape,{{TCW|Counterattack}} resulting in the Republic dispatching a [[Lola Sayu task force|task force]] of four ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers led by Jedi Master [[Plo Koon]] to extract the trapped rescue team, forcing the dreadnought and the rest of the planetary defense fleet to engage the Republic task force.{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}} ====Capture and rescue of Adi Gallia==== At some point during the Clone Wars, the Kaleesh cyborg General Grievous and his fleet of Separatist cruisers launched a surprise [[Battle of Patitite Pattuna|attack]] on Jedi Master [[Adi Gallia]] and her [[Adi Gallia's flagship|flagship]] near the planet [[Patitite Pattuna]] aboard his [[Grievous's Providence-class carrier/destroyer (Patitite Pattuna)|personal]] ''Providence''-class cruiser-carrier, and successfully managed to capture her after engaging one another in a lightsaber duel aboard her Star Destroyer.{{TCW|Nomad Droids}} [[File:KoonFleetRescue-ND.png|thumb|left|270px|Grievous's cruiser comes under attack from Plo Koon's fleet.]] Some time after her capture, Grievous aboard his Providence crossed paths with the [[Weequay pirate ship]] [[Marauder (Weequay pirate ship)|''Marauder'']], and immediately ordered the bridge crew to use it for target practice and destroy it. And while still being held captive aboard the dreadnought, a [[Plo Koon's second fleet|fleet]] of Republic Star Destroyers led by Jedi Master Plo Koon entered the system and began to fusillade the Separatist dreadnought, and successfully managed to [[Rescue of Adi Gallia|retrieve]] Master Gallia while Grievous made his escape from the heavily damaged cruiser. ====Battle of Umbara==== Around the [[20 BBY|second year]] of the war,''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the [[Battle of Mon Cala]] and the [[Plan to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine|skirmish in Theed]] to [[20 BBY]]. As the episode this event takes place within takes place between the events of the episodes the other events are attached to according to {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}}, this event must also take place 20 BBY. the [[Umbaran government]] seceded from the Republic after the death of Senator [[Mee Deechi]],{{TCW|Senate Murders}} who had represented the planet in the [[Galactic Senate]], and aligned themselves with the Separatist Alliance. The Separatists established a [[Umbara blockade|blockade]], led by a dreadnought when the Republic forces undertook a planetary-wide [[Battle of Umbara|invasion]] to reclaim the planet.{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}} [[File:SpaceBattleOfUmbara1-PoD.png|thumb|right|300px|The Separatist armada defending the Separatist supply ship.]] As the battle raged on, the Separatists dispatched a [[Unidentified Separatist supply ship|DH-Omni Support Vessel]] to reinforce the crumbling [[Umbaran Militia|Umbaran forces]] in hopes of defeating the Republic troops led by Jedi Generals Kenobi, Skywalker and Pong Krell. To ensure that the supply ship reached its destination, the Separatists defended the vessel with a fleet including at least three Separatist dreadnoughts, four ''Recusant''-class light destroyers, and eight ''Munificent''-class star frigates.{{TCW|Plan of Dissent}} ====Massacre of the Nightsisters==== After Asajj Ventress' failed [[Mission to Serenno (Nightsisters)|attempt]] to kill her former master Count Dooku and the betrayal of his new apprentice [[Savage Opress]], and upon learning that his former assassin had returned to the planet [[Dathomir]], Dooku ordered General Grievous to launch an [[Battle of Dathomir|invasion]] on the planet with the intent of exacting revenge on Ventress and [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Talzin]] and wiping out the entire [[Nightsisters|Nightsister]] clan.{{TCW|Massacre}} Commanding his fleet of four ''Munificent''-class star frigates, two ''Recusant''-class light destroyers, two Separatist [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel|supply ships]], and his personal Separatist dreadnought, Grievous and his forces traveled to the [[Dathomir system]]. Upon their arrival, Grievous ordered the Separatist forces to begin landing their droids on the surface below, successfully killing the Nightsister clan. ====Infiltration of Aut-O's flagship==== [[File:TCW_Separatist_fleet_SW.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Aut-O's fleet]]]] Later on in the war, the Republic, fearful of a major Separatist offensive on the verge of occurring after a secret transmission of General Grievous was cut off, dispatched a [[D-Squad|squad]] of droids led by [[Zilkin]] [[Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon]] to [[Mission to steal a Separatist encryption module|infiltrate]] a [[Aut-O's flagship|Separatist dreadnought]] commanded by the [[ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|super tactical droid]] [[Aut-O]] which was carrying an [[encryption module]] that would allow the Republic to learn of the Separatists' plans.{{TCW|Secret Weapons}} ====Ambushing Kenobi==== Sometime later, General Kenobi and his task force were [[Attack on Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet|ambushed]] by the Separatist fleet of General Grievous. The fleet consisted of two ''Providence''-class Dreadnoughts, one ''Recusant''-class destroyer, and three Munificent-class star frigates, one of which was destroyed in the battle. The ambush resulted in the destruction of much of Kenobi's fleet, including his flagship ''Negotiator''.{{TCW|Bound for Rescue}} ====Defense of Cato Neimoidia==== In the [[19 BBY|final year]] of the war,''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the [[Battle of Mandalore|Battle of Sundari]] and [[Ahsoka Tano]]'s departure from the [[Jedi Order]] to [[19 BBY]]. As the episode this event takes place within takes place between the events of the episodes the other events are attached to according to {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}}, this event must take place in 19 BBY. the Separatists invaded the Trade Federation planet of [[Cato Neimoidia]], but were met with a Republic [[Defense of Cato Neimoidia|defense]] led by Skywalker, his [[Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], and the 501st Legion. After punching through the Separatist fleet in orbit, the two Jedi led a squadron of [[Clone Z-95 starfighter|Z-95 Headhunters]] to the surface to engage the command ship and its accompanying cruisers.{{TCW|Sabotage (episode)}} ====Battle of Ringo Vinda==== During the [[Battle of Ringo Vinda]], Separatist forces commanded by Admiral Trench used five ''Providence''-class vessels while trying to repel the Republic forces on and outside the planet's ring-shaped [[Ringo Vinda space station|space station]]. The dreadnoughts were paired with two ''Recusant''-class vessels, and suffered severe damage from the Republic's fleet of twenty ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers, one ''Arquitens''-class light cruiser, one ''Acclamator''-class assault ship and three ''Consular''-class cruisers during the battle.{{TCW|The Unknown}} ====Invasion of Scipio==== [[File:Dookuwalksin-CrisisattheHeart.png|thumb|right|250px|Count Dooku steps onto the bridge of his ''Providence''-class flagship during the Battle of Scipio, his goals already accomplished.]] During the [[Invasion of Scipio|invasion]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]] world of [[Scipio]], Count Dooku commanded the battle from his personal [[Dooku's Providence-class carrier/destroyer|''Providence''-class Dreadnought]]. After he had completed his mission to trick [[Rush Clovis]] into raising interest rates on the Republic and not the Separatists, with the arrival of a Republic fleet commanded by Anakin Skywalker, Dooku and his [[Dooku's flotilla|flotilla]] fled the [[Scipio system/Legends|system]], allowing the Republic to gain control of Scipio. With Dooku's actions, Clovis appeared as if he was a Separatist agent from the start, giving Palpatine the pretext needed to nationalize the banks and furthering the Sith plan.{{TCW|Crisis at the Heart}} ====Fighting the Shadow Collective==== [[File:GrievousFleet-DMSOD1.png|thumb|left|270px|Grievous's ''Providence''-class Dreadnought leads a fleet to Zanbar.]] During the Confederacy's [[Campaign against the Shadow Collective|campaign]] against the [[Shadow Collective]], a criminal organization founded by the former Sith Lord [[Maul]], Grievous commanded a large Separatist fleet in a [[Battle of Zanbar|battle]] on the moon of [[Zanbar]] after the [[Zabrak]] managed to [[Escape from the Spire|escape]] from the [[Spire (Stygeon Prime)|Spire]] prison on the planet [[Stygeon Prime]]. The fleet consisted of Grievous' [[Grievous's Providence-class Dreadnought (Campaign against the Shadow Collective)|''Providence''-class Dreadnought]], at least two ''Recusant''-class warships, at least eighteen ''Munificent''-class star frigates, at least five DH-Omni Support Vessels, and at least five C-9979 landing craft.[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 1|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 1]] Following their defeat at Zanbar, Maul and Mother Talzin, who had suspicions that the Sith and Separatists were attempting to draw her out, devised a plan to lure Count Dooku and Grievous to the planet [[Ord Mantell]] where they set a trap to capture both. The Separatists, after landing their droid forces on the surface, were immediately [[Battle on Ord Mantell|engaged]] by the Shadow Collective, while Maul made his way onto the dreadnought, where Grievous was ordered to deactivate his army or be killed, to which the cyborg chose to shut down his army, allowing himself to be captured. Dooku, meanwhile, who had engaged and defeated the Nightbrothers on the surface, was also captured by the Collective forces.[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 2|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 2]] ====Outer Rim Sieges==== =====Battle for Anaxes===== [[File:ProvidencesOverAnaxes-TBB.png|thumb|right|270px|Three ''Providence''-class Dreadnoughts in the Battle over Anaxes.]] During the [[Outer Rim Sieges]],{{TCW|A Distant Echo}} the Separatists, under Trench's command, launched an [[Battle of Anaxes|assault]] on the planet [[Anaxes]] in an attempt to secure the Republic's [[Anaxes shipyards|shipyards]] that were instrumental to its [[Republic Navy|navy]]. The Harch commanded the battle from aboard his new flagship, the ''[[Invulnerable]]'',{{TCW|Unfinished Business (episode)}} in an orbiting fleet with at least two other ''Providence''-class Dreadnoughts, seven ''Munificent''-class star frigates,{{TCW|The Bad Batch (episode)}} two ''Recusant''-class light destroyers, and six DH-Omni Support Vessels. In the initial phases of the battle, the Republic managed to keep Trench's [[Trench's army|forces]] contained, but after [[Standard week|weeks]] of endless fighting, the Separatists were able to gain the upper hand by using a [[Rex's battle strategy algorithm|strategy algorithm]] designed by Clone Captain Rex, which had been extracted from clone trooper [[Echo]], who was thought to have been killed during the Battle of Lola Sayu earlier in the war, on [[Skako Minor]], the Techno Union [[Purkoll Tower Base|headquarters]]. =====Later sieges===== Later in the Outer Rim Sieges, Grievous commanded a fleet of six ''Providence''-class vessels [[Battle between a Republic and Separatist fleet|against]] a fleet of six Republic Star Destroyers. During the battle, at least two Separatist dreadnoughts sustained heavy damage to their hulls as clone Z-95 Headhunters and droid tri-fighters engaged in dogfights around them.{{TCW|Old Friends Not Forgotten}} [[File:CaptureOfCatoNeimoidia.png|thumb|left|250px|Jedi Master Plo Koon leads starfighter squadrons against three Providences.]] As the end of the war neared, the Republic sought to [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia|capitulate]] the planet Cato Neimoidia, seeing it as an instrumental goal that would help bring an end to the conflict.[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] The [[Jedi High Council|Jedi Council]] dispatched Plo Koon to lead''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' the [[442nd Siege Battalion]]{{WebCite|url=http://www.entertainmentearth.com/prodinfo.asp?number=HSC0495|text=Star Wars Black Series Clone Troopers of Order 66|date=2016-10-06|archivedate=20161006030615}} and ensure the planet's capture. Koon and Clone Captain [[Jag]] led starfighter squadrons against a trio of Separatist dreadnoughts and droid tri-fighters in the skies of Cato Neimoidia. ====Battle of Coruscant==== Nearing the end of the war, the Confederacy—under orders of Darth Sidious, the secret persona of the Republic's Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine, and the CIS' shadow leader—launched a massive and unanticipated [[Battle of Coruscant|assault]] on the Republic's capital of [[Coruscant]] in the Core Worlds to capture Palpatine in order to bring Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker closer to the dark side of the Force. [[File:InvisibleHand-SWM.png|thumb|right|350px|The ''Invisible Hand'' led the Separatist forces at the Battle of Coruscant.]] Despite the high belief that the Separatists would never make such an attempt, Grievous made his move on the Republic's capital with a fleet of over 1,000 starships aboard the Separatist navy's flagship, the ''Providence''-class Dreadnought ''[[Invisible Hand]]'',{{Databank|general-grievous|General Grievous}} which managed to catch the ill-prepared [[Coruscant Home Defense Fleet]] off guard and quickly overwhelm them, with the Chancellor, after a lengthy chase through the [[Federal District]], taken captive aboard the flagship.''[[Star Wars Lightsabers: A Guide to Weapons of the Force]]'' Despite being outnumbered, the Home Fleet attempted to prevent the ''Invisible Hand'' from escaping with the Chancellor. Before the Separatists could escape from Coruscant, the Republic's [[Open Circle Fleet]] and Jedi Generals Kenobi and Skywalker arrived and immediately engaged the Separatists' Munificents, Recusants and Lucrehulks, which were escorting the ''Invisible Hand'', and allowed the two Jedi to enter the heart of the chaos of turbolaser fire and starships. After a brief struggle to reach the flagship, Skywalker deactivated the ships deflector shields, which allowed the pair to land inside the vessel's main hangar. [[File:Handsplits.png|thumb|left|300px|The ''Invisible Hand'' split in half during the battle.]] While aboard the ''Invisible Hand'', the Jedi released the Chancellor from captivity and killed Count Dooku. Shortly after, the dreadnought came into a brief broadside battle with the ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer [[Guarlara (Venator-class)|''Guarlara'']]. The dreadnought took extensive damage from the Venator, which sent it plummeting towards the planet below before the crew regained control. Despite the Chancellor's rescue and a third of the fleet being destroyed, Grievous escaped from his doomed flagship aboard an escape pod, which was retrieved by the ''Lucrehulk''-class Battleship ''[[Profusion]]''. As Grievous fled, Skywalker and Kenobi still aboard the ''Invisible Hand'', managed to land the dreadnought on Coruscant's surface, with half of the vessel breaking off in the process. ===Imperial Era=== {{Quote|Analysis of data received by the command center's friend-or-foe indicator confirms that the capital ship is a downsized version of a Separatist ''Providence''-class cruiser-carrier, modified with modules taken from CIS frigates and destroyers. Ships of the sort made a name for themselves during the war by jamming signals and destroying HoloNet relays.|An Imperial [[technician]], to Moff Wilhuff Tarkin|}} Following the [[Mission to Mustafar|end]] of the Clone Wars and the [[Proclamation of the New Order|transition]] of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire]]{{TBB|Battle Scars}} in 19 BBY,"[[Battle Scars]]" takes place shortly after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]. the ''Providence''-class Dreadnoughts were decommissioned and sent to the junkyard world of [[Bracca]] to be dismantled. While on Bracca, dreadnoughts began to deteriorate shortly into the Imperial Era as their hulls became rusted. [[File:Reinforcement-Providence-Carrier.png|thumb|right|270px|A ''Providence''-class Carrier in service to the Rebel Alliance]] Later during the Empire's [[Imperial Era|reign]] in [[14 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']] to [[14 BBY]]. a [[Berch Teller's rebel cell|rebel cell]] led by [[Berch Teller]] made use of a modified and downsized [[Berch Teller's warship|version]] of a former Separatist ''Providence''-class Dreadnought well-known for jamming signals and destroying [[HoloNet]] relays during the war. The dreadnought was an amalgamation of several of dreadnoughts used by the Separatists, including the ''[[Lucid Voice]]'', which made up the vessel's [[sensor array]] tower, and the ''Invincible'', the former flagship of Admiral Trench during the Battle of Christophsis, which were recovered and put on the market after the battle, and used as part of the warship's modules. The dreadnought participated in the cell's [[Attack on Sentinel Base|attack]] on the Imperial [[Sentinel Base]] during [[Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]]'s stay at the base. The ''Lucid Voice'' later participated in a [[Battle near the Gulf of Tatooine|battle]] near the [[Gulf of Tatooine]], where it was destroyed by Imperial forces led by Tarkin. Another [[Unidentified Providence-class carrier/destroyer (Rebel Alliance)|Providence]] with an expanded stern and engines would go on to serve in the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|naval forces]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] where it would partake in a [[Battle between the Rebel Alliance and Empire|battle]] against [[Star Destroyer|star destroyers]] of the [[Imperial Navy]] alongside newer Mon Cala warships.{{FFGXW2|set=Core Set|cardname=Predator}} ==Behind the scenes== The ''Providence''-class Dreadnought first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. In the original continuity, the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] identified the ship as the ''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer,{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050811a|text=Starships and Vehicles of ''Revenge of the Sith''}} but with the discarding of the Expanded Universe in favor of a new continuity on [[April 25]], [[2014]],{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}} the initial official name was "Separatist dreadnought."
